Also, the driver of a car suspected of causing a fuel tanker to overturn on a major highway in Egypt is detained. Plus Sierra Leone was once considered the most dangerous place in the world to give birth. Today, maternal deaths have dropped…

items.title: Albania's youth are protesting, no longer leaving the country
items.desc: Youth protests against a rigid political system and corruption have shaken the government of Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama. They also show that fewer young people are willing to emigrate in search of a better future.

items.title: Guinea-Bissau junta delays presidential vote for 2 years
items.desc: The decision came exactly one year after the military took power on November 26, 2025. The junta said the conditions were insufficient to hold presidential elections for now.

items.title: Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US
items.desc: Hundreds of thousands have been affected by storms in the country as the Thanksgiving holiday weekend begins.
